attr.title: NVForever 0.3.3 (experimental)
attr.desc: Native ARM64 NVForever port for TrimUI Smart Pro. Includes optional developer tools, idle-work optimizations and diagnostics. Requires separately owned Fallout: New Vegas PC game data. Performance is experimental and scene-dependent.
attr.inst: Requires your own Fallout: New Vegas PC Data folder in nvforever/game/Data. First launch automatically creates/reuses a 2 GiB swap file on internal UDISK; about 2.25 GiB free is needed when creating it. Saves/settings are kept on update. Developer menu off by default; enable with home/dev-menu.ini. TrimUI Smart Pro only. See README.txt.
